snippet.title: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics - Demo Launch & Console Announcement Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Prospice: Anomalous Logistics: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4067370/Prospice_Anomalous_Logistics/

The demo for Prospice is now available on Steam! Venture onto an uncharted island warped by the remains of decaying gods, exploring its mysteries with your trusty off-road truck. Plot routes through treacherous terrain, keep remote outposts supplied, and dare to leave safety and your truck behind to uncover occult artifacts and forgotten truths. 

Prospice launches in 2027 on Steam, PlayStation 5, and XBOX Series X|S.

Prospice: Anomalous Logistics Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4067370/Prospice_Anomalous_Logistics/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020854
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/prospice-anomolous-logistics/9NK1ZZ7BSDJD

--

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
